prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Explore Your Companion Options", "Compare instant pre-made desktop companions with fully custom AI pets before picking your path.", "Compare Experiences"]
2: ["Try Controlling Your Companion", "Test dragging, summoning, and hiding your desktop pet before completing setup.", "Test Summon & Hide"]
3: ["Your Pet is Ready! Sign In to Save", "Create or sign into your account now to sync your new pet to cloud backup.", "Syncing prevents pet reset when reopening the app."]
4: ["Your Companion is Hatching!", "We are preparing your pet's desktop AI personality engine."]
5: ["Already built a pet before? Make sure to use the exact same login method (Google/Apple/Email) to restore your pet."]
6: ["Claim Your Companion's Official Certificate", "Finalize your pet's name to unlock an exclusive Starter Toy & Accessory Pack!", "Unlocked: Golden Collar & Starter Toy Pack"]
7: ["Pre-made: Instant hatch, 100+ animations | Custom: Unique AI look, custom traits"]
8: ["Rendering takes a minute. We will notify your desktop screen as soon as your pet arrives!"]
9: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Your pet is now exploring your desktop! Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon, hide, or open pet controls.", "Let's Play!"]

verdicts.problem: Promises free extras or exclusive gift incentives.
